title: TrackScout project settings
description: Optional, served at GET /data/trackscout.json (the reference server reads data/trackscout.json from its data folder). Every field is optional and the file itself is optional: a 404 means the app keeps its own defaults. Place it next to the questions you serve to brand the app for your track and tune its behaviour per project.

name.description: The project name shown in the app (onboarding, headers).

alert_radius_meters.description: Default radius around a place at which the app alerts the owner of open questions. The owner can still change it in Settings; walking pace suits ~40 m, cycling 60-80 m.

start_offset_minutes.description: Minutes after sunset until the night-photo window opens (default 30).

end_hour.description: Fractional local hour at which the night-photo window closes; 23.5 means 23:30 (default 23.5).

night_window.description: When the app considers it 'night' for photo planning (night-lighting questions and the 3-per-day night-photo cap). Omit to keep the app defaults.
